newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3910/3.3948 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3910/3.3948 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3860 to 3.3940 bid and 3.3940 to 3.3960 in the interbank market on Monday.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3910 pounds bid and 3.3948 offered. The averages compared with 3.3938 pounds bid and 3.3958 offered on Sunday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) as 3.392518 buy and 3.398038 sell.
